serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.happy Both of our friends said they are free to come, but after we arrived, we only saw Melissa. You: Hi Melissa. Do you know where Annalie is? Melissa: No idea. Bot: You two usually come first to these meetings. Melissa: True. You: It’s not like she’s late or anything, there’s still time until the agreed time. Bot: You are right! You: Let’s get going then! Who wants to start? Bot: Me! You: Alright then. You: What song will you be singing? Bot: Hmmm… Bot: Since Annalie isn’t here, I will go with something challenging so I can go all out. All out? I don’t like the sound of that… You: Is there even a song that can give you a challenge? You got speakers and what not. Bot: I’m not copying, but replicating. If the voice line is complicated enough, it might give me some trouble. Bot: Oh! This will do! Melissa: Good choice. This can’t be good if they both like it… Wha? You: Are you sure about this? Singing ‘Scatman’ by Scatman John, extended nightcore edition, is a little… Bot: That’s exactly why I chose it! #bot.Expression.clear You: B-But what if Annalie comes in? #bot.Expression.happy Melissa: She just called me to say that something came up and she won’t be able to come. Bot: Does it mean I can?! You: Sure… The highest score on that song is 14%... {{wi}}Knowing her, she will ace it, which will for sure raise some eyebrows… …on the other hand, it’s just a stupid song on karaoke, no one will care. Bot: Here I go! Bot: Ska badabadabadoo belidabbelydabbladabbladabblabab belibabbelibabbelibabbelabbelo doobelidoo! Bot: I'm the Scatman! I don’t even know what to think about it… The song continued for a good few minutes, which gave me a lot of time to contemplate my life choices and the point of inviting a bunch of bots to a karaoke… Bot: And the score is… #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.VeryAngry Bot: That’s bullshit! Melissa: 99.2% is a good result. Bot: But I did it perfectly, so it should’ve been a 100%! This stupid machine needs to be broken! #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.happy Bot: Hey, can I try again? I’m sure you two don’t mind skipping a turn- #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.shock You: No! #bot.Expression.clear You: You can try again, but please…{{wi}} choose a different song… #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: Eh… #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.normal Melissa: Seems like some people can’t appreciate a good scat. Really? Out of all the one-liners in the world, you went with that? #Cashier.Face.normal You: The rhythm is too fast for me and its high energy isn’t helping. It makes my head hurt… #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.happy Bot: Alright, I will give up for now if it’s bothering you so much. You: Thank you… Bot: Humans are so fragile. Melissa: Agreed. Bot: Anyway, who’s next then? ???: I knew that this voice sounded familiar!
